entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers expected to about 1000 metres Tuesday afternoon, lowering to 700 metres in the evening. Expect 1cm or less to settle about the Lindis Pass summit with snow flurries to 700 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow lowering to 800 metres. Expect 1 to 2 cm to accumulate about the summit of Porters Pass with lesser amounts to 800 metres.
